title: Great.
text:
We took a 2-hour sailing tour, with friends, for an EVG. The boat was very beautiful, and our skipper was very, very nice. The aperitif was simple, but nice.
We were also able to go to the front of the boat and enjoy a wonderful view of the ocean.
It was really a timeless experience, where we could talk quietly while enjoying the view.
author: Corentin_L

title: Great fun!
text: Victor, our skipper, was so friendly and funny! We had such a great time on board. So much fun. Was very easy to find the boat and the people were very responsive!
author: Keshana_K

title: After the cars, planes and trains
text:
After nine days of cars, planes and trains, getting out on the water for a three hour sail was most rewarding. Our Captain Oriol was a true professional. I've never seen a 45 foot, twin sail, boat managed by a crew of one. He set the main and jib sails as soon as we cleared the jetty. He was gracious in his manner; professional in his seamanship. He added a unique approach to the history of the Barcelona coast and seaport.
Then he went above and beyond. There was a communication error between our driver and his dispatcher. Oriol did not leave for home until the driver showed up 40 minutes late
author: hawkeyeod

title: Unique experience in Barcelona
text: Amazing experience. Very personalized, unique and fun boat ride. This activity is perfect for a day with friends. You get some drinks and snacks to enjoy during the ride. The boat is super spacious and clean. The skipper was super friendly, puntual and adapted so well to our group. Highly recommend!
author: Michelle_T

title: Awesome experience!
text: Our trip was amazing! Staff did everything to make our boat trip unforgettable. Would recommend!! They provided us with endless snacks and drinks :)

title: What a gorgeous experience for us...
text: What a gorgeous experience for us Great Lake Americans, might be cold for those local. The captain was professional and treated us like VIPs. His navigation and timing put us facing directly into the sunset which was superb, obviously a seasoned sailor. The trip actually went off a day late due to the holiday that we did not know was occurring when we booked but through excellent communication we had no real issues in the end.
author: amy_o
